correctness.rationale: Reassessed the narrowed complete census in the corrected RESULT.md. For h≤3, two equal-Parikh subsequences suffice because every permutation is dihedral. Parity-character filtering gives (3^(2h)+3)/4 indexed even words. Every balanced partition of the known witness pairs adjacent with opposite zero positions. The original direct verifier is exhaustive over half-position subsets and doubled-string rotation or reflection; independently, python3 /workspace/audit_replay/shuffle.py constructs all successful words forward by interleaving each half-word with each dihedral image over every mask, and takes the complement among even words. It gives success counts 3,21,183,1593, exactly 48 length-eight failures, and equality with the specified orbit. The replay is finite and gives no information for larger lengths.
